patch_description:
The prior results show that aggressive parameter sharing substantially improves generalization, loss, and convergence, while independent per-qubit parameters tend to overfit. This design retains the efficient four-parameter collective block but replaces the cube-specific entangler with an exactly permutation-invariant complete-graph parity lens.

Every unordered qubit pair receives a CZ gate, making the entangler invariant under the full S8 qubit-permutation group rather than only the smaller symmetry group of a chosen sparse graph. This matches the unordered-pair feature encoding and mean-Z readout without introducing additional trainable parameters. The complete graph is scheduled as seven disjoint perfect matchings to limit entangling depth. Collective RY/RZ ingress rotations expose the uploaded phases, while complementary RY/RX decoding rotations convert both real and imaginary coherence components into the fixed Z measurements. The result still has only four circuit parameters per block and 26 total parameters, but gains dense high-order correlation capacity without sacrificing parameter efficiency.
